0022600204.text: The Charlotte Hornets host the Cleveland Cavaliers in the Hornets' 11th game of the season, and Charlotte enters at 3-7, 2-4 at home, on a six-game losing streak, fourth in the Southeast and 11th in the East. Cleveland is 5-4 overall, 4-1 at home and 1-3 on the road, riding a one-game winning streak, and sits second in the Central and sixth in the East. Charlotte is without Dennis Schroder (thigh), Grant Williams (hamstring) and Kon Knueppel (hamstring strain), and Brandon Miller (groin soreness) and Moussa Diabate (quadriceps) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, while Cleveland is missing Jarrett Allen (knee), Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Sam Merrill (elbow); the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Hornets lost the season series 1-3, including a 118-113 loss in Charlotte on February 20, 2026.
